$comment: AWP frame test vectors (AWP-DAT-008). Decode `hex`; compare to `expect`, or require the error in `expect_error`. Generated with scripts/frame-codec.mjs.

vectors.name: minimal
vectors.description: No flags, no extensions, 16-byte JSON payload.

vectors.name: keyframe_tick
vectors.description: Keyframe on a per-tick lockstep channel with tick=4212 (extension 0x01).

vectors.name: tick_and_ts_sim
vectors.description: tick=4212 and ts_sim_ns=4212000000 (extensions 0x01 and 0x02); end-of-burst set.

vectors.name: negative_ts_sim
vectors.description: ts_sim_ns is i64: negative value (sim time before anchor).

vectors.name: streaming_ts_send
vectors.description: Streaming observation frame: keyframe with ts_send_ns=913004120200 (extension 0x03), 8.2 ms after capture.

vectors.name: unknown_extension
vectors.description: Reserved type 0x3f (len 3) must be skipped; vendor type 0x9a (len 2) is surfaced.

vectors.name: zero_payload
vectors.description: Keyframe with payload_len=0 and no extensions.

vectors.name: reserved_bits_set
vectors.description: Reserved flag bits 4-7 set by a newer sender; receiver ignores them (decoded flags mask to bits 0-3).

vectors.name: resync_keyframe
vectors.description: First frame after resumption on a reliable channel: keyframe with resync (flag bit 3) and no extensions (AWP-DAT-009).

vectors.name: max_seq_safe
vectors.description: seq and ts_mono_ns at 2^53-1, the largest values permitted in JSON (AWP-CTL-009).

vectors.name: ext_len_exceeds_frame
vectors.description: flags bit 2 set, ext_len=0x0020 but only 10 bytes follow.

vectors.name: wrong_registered_len
vectors.description: tick (0x01) declared with len 4; registered length is 8.

vectors.name: wrong_registered_len_ts_send
vectors.description: ts_send_ns (0x03) declared with len 4; registered length is 8.

vectors.name: duplicate_type
vectors.description: Two tick entries in one frame.

vectors.name: payload_len_mismatch
vectors.description: payload_len says 4 but 2 bytes present.

vectors.name: bad_magic
vectors.description: Magic is not AWPF.

vectors.name: unknown_version
vectors.description: Version 2: not a version this revision defines (AWP-DAT-010).

vectors.name: trailing_bytes
vectors.description: One byte beyond the length the header gives (AWP-DAT-010).

vectors.name: resync_without_keyframe
vectors.description: Resync flag (bit 3) without keyframe (bit 0) (AWP-DAT-010).

vectors.name: seq_over_2p53
vectors.description: seq = 2^53 exceeds the JSON-safe bound (AWP-CTL-009).
